Func - Unflatten-From-String Error handler.vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Development

Use this VI in FuncVIs to handle errors produced by the Unflatten From String function.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

InstanceRef is the reference to the CalcExpress instance that evaluates a CalcExpress expression.
Unflatten Error status specifies if an error occurred during conversion of data from Flattened-To-String format to native LabVIEW data format. If TRUE, the VI puts relevant error message to the Error Protocol.
argument number is used to specify an argument number on which the error occurred. If it is greater than or equal to 1, the VI puts the argument number to an error description to simplify debugging; otherwise, the VI omits argument number information. Keep it unwired if a FuncVI operates on single argument. By default, argument number is equal to -1.
error in specifies an error status before this VI executes. The VI runs normally only if error in is FALSE.
error out returns TRUE if either error in is TRUE or the VI detects an error condition. If an error detected, the VI puts an error description to the Error Protocol.

 

Func - Unflatten-From-String Error handler.vi - details

The VI is intended for use in FuncVIs.
A FuncVI obtains an argument value in the Flattened-To-String format if the argument type is either one of Complex types or a user-defined data type. The VI tests an error condition returned by the Unflatten From String LabVIEW function, which is used to convert an argument value from the Flattened-To-String format to its native format. If a conversion error status is passed to the VI, it posts the error description to the Error Protocol.

This type of error is atypical. It cannot occur unless a specified argument type mismatches its flattened data. Care must be taken wherever a user-defined data type is bound with flattened data; for example, when returning a FuncVI result.

For details, see the FuncVI Development topic. Also see Example of use.
